description: Fast 2-kernel tile-shape A/B for the B=120 H=4 N=16384 d=64 infer shape. A = fair HEUR baseline (base-tile mtile=128, sequence<128,64,32,64,32,64>, wk32) and B = fastest winner (sequence<192,32,32,64,32,64>, mtile=64, wk32). The two differ in mtile AND km0 AND kn0, so a pure axis product cannot express exactly two disjoint tuples; this is the smallest product superset (2x2x2 = 8 corners) that the validity gates keep. PIN IT TO EXACTLY A AND B with the benchmark --filter expr: "(c.mtile==128 and c.km0==128 and c.kn0==64) or (c.mtile==64 and c.km0==192 and c.kn0==32)". All combos share kn0sub=32, kn1=64, kk1=32, warp_k=32, splitkv=0; warp_k=32 (16x16x32) is required for d=64 to compile. Use --only-problem step5_infer_b120_n16384_h4 and --build-dir /tmp/hstu_tileshape_build to reuse the cached libs.
